Tabs Usage

<Tabs defaultIndex={0}>

    <Tabs.Tab index={0}>First</Tabs.Tab>

  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Panels>

    <Tabs.Panel>Second panel content</Tabs.Panel>
    <Tabs.Panel>Third panel content</Tabs.Panel>
  </Tabs.Panels>
</Tabs>
